name: Valley of Fangs
summary: The Valley of Fangs is a rugged, narrow pass carved between towering rock pillars in the central Badlands. Known for the vicious predators that prowl its dusty floor, it also shelters a small, isolated encampment of wandering tinkerers and exiles.

sections.title: A Treacherous Pass
sections.body: Situated between two imposing stone formations in the heart of the Badlands, the Valley of Fangs earns its name from both the sharp silhouettes of its surrounding cliffs and the dangerous beasts roaming its floor. Feral crag coyotes, prowling cougars, and vicious wolves stalk the dusty corridor, making transit hazardous for lone travelers. Despite the hostile wildlife, a handful of wayward figures—including the banished orc Martek the Exiled and his goblin associates Rigglefuzz and Jazzrik—have pitched an informal camp here, tinkering away in seclusion far from the regional outposts.

faq.q: Where is the Valley of Fangs located?
faq.answer: The Valley of Fangs lies in the central Badlands, tucked between two massive natural rock formations south of the main northern ridgeline.

faq.q: Who lives in the Valley of Fangs?
aliases: who is in valley of fangs
faq.answer: A small wayside camp can be found here, home to the lone orc Martek the Exiled and his tinkering goblin companions, Rigglefuzz and Jazzrik.

faq.q: Why is the valley dangerous to travel through?
aliases: what attacks you in valley of fangs
faq.answer: The valley floor is heavily populated by aggressive wildlife native to the Badlands, notably predatory cougars, wolves, and coyotes that ambush wanderers in the narrow terrain.

faq.q: Why did Martek and the goblins set up here?
aliases: why camp in valley of fangs
faq.answer: Cast out and wandering the wastes, Martek the Exiled found a quiet, defensible niche between the rock walls alongside goblin associates willing to trade and tinker away from the prying eyes of major factions.

angles.text: The goblin tinkerers camped in the Valley of Fangs draw curious engineers seeking unconventional know-how in the middle of the arid wastes.
The dense population of tough cougars and wolves makes the valley a prime hunting ground for tracking quarry and taming rugged Badlands beasts.
